spec: SPEC.md v0.2, with approved lossless-expression-boundary clarification in section 6.8
scope: Section 12 corpus gate for go version go1.26.3 darwin/arm64, active files; behavioral test flags and skips are recorded below.

stdlib.scope: Host GOOS/GOARCH and build constraints; GoFiles, CgoFiles, TestGoFiles, XTestGoFiles.
stdlib.meaning: L1 byte equality, L2 deterministic lifting, L3 formatter idempotence, and L4 code-only Go token/directive equality. Mandatory folds and package behavior are checked separately.

module.scope: Host GOOS/GOARCH and build constraints; GoFiles, CgoFiles, TestGoFiles, XTestGoFiles.
module.meaning: L1 byte equality, L2 deterministic lifting, L3 formatter idempotence, and L4 code-only Go token/directive equality. Mandatory folds and package behavior are checked separately.

limits: This is a corpus-based gate, not a proof for every Go program or every normative clause.
Inactive build variants, historical toolchains, and tests skipped by the recorded -short profile are not validated.
Test notes remain in both behavioral modes so Example output assertions run; production notes are removed in without-notes mode.
Token measurements cover encoding/json and the spec example; no model-accuracy or latency claim.
